assumptions.losses: U1 ESP32 0.6 W, U41 regulator 0.5 W, and U61 Ethernet PHY 0.25 W are illustrative power-budget inputs, not measured board losses.
assumptions.thermal_paths: All component heat is assigned through 5 mm square board contacts and assumed junction-case/case-board resistances.
assumptions.board: Uniform effective in-plane conductivity 20 W/mK, 1.6 mm thickness and 10 W/m2K convection on both faces are exploratory assumptions; airflow, package solids, copper detail and enclosure are not resolved.
